To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a hybrid neural-guiding and genetic programming approach is effective for symbolic regression, that the two methods can be decoupled to improve performance, and that we introduce a new benchmark suite for symbolic regression.

we propose a hybrid neural-guiding/genetic programming approach that outperforms a recent state-of-the-art model on symbolic regression benchmarks, and we introduce a new benchmark set for future research.

(1) a neural-guided genetic programming hybrid is an effective approach to solve symbolic regression problems; (2) a hybrid that uses the neural-guided model only for initial population seeding is more effective than hybrids where the neural-guided and genetic programming models are more tightly coupled; (3) the neural-guided hybrid can be used to solve combinatorial optimization tasks other than symbolic regression; and (4) we introduce 22 new benchmark symbolic regression problems.
